summary: Frontend re-test of the reload regression fix (Expo web, 375x667, demo mode). All 5 requested items PASS. Reload on /campaigns keeps the list: 40 campaign cards and a total of 59,528, with no empty state. Reload on /settings fills the Account card (Avery Nguyen, Acme Demo Co., plan) and shows no spinner. Reload on /contacts loads the list: '60 contacts' header and 25 rows. /oauth-complete when logged out goes to /login. When logged in it goes to /campaigns with no 'Sign in failed' toast, and the user is still on /campaigns after waiting past the 8s safety-net timer. Switching between Campaigns, Contacts and Settings 5 times caused no regression. The tab bar is opaque white on web. No page errors.

issues: The 'Demo data' pill floats over list content above the tab bar and partly covers rows and cards. It has pointerEvents=none, so this is cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: (tabs)/_layout.tsx: gating on BrevoContext.loading before mounting Tabs fixes the iteration_3 race. Screens now mount with the token already set.
oauth-complete.tsx: connectedRef removes the stale closure in the 8s timer. The logic is correct.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the 'Use sample data' demo session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo login: [data-testid=login-demo-button] on /login. Tabs: a[href='/campaigns'|'/contacts'|'/settings']. Cards: [data-testid^=campaign-card-], rows: [data-testid^=contact-row-], account: [data-testid=settings-account]. The session persists in localStorage, so page.reload() keeps it. Real Brevo OAuth is out of scope.
rca_of_issue: The iteration_3 reload bug is resolved. The tabs layout now shows a spinner until the persisted session has loaded.
